;
;----------------------------
        .IF     PASS
PASS    EQU     1
REPTCNT EQU     1
        .ENDIF
;
        DEFMAC  GENSINUS
;
        ORG     SIN_ADR
        DEFB    SIN_X/256
        ORG     $+127
        DEFB    0-(SIN_X/256)
;
        ORG     SIN_ADR-1+(REPTCNT*2)
        DEFB    SIN_X/256
        ORG     $+127
        DEFB    0-(SIN_X/256)
;
SIN_ADR =       SIN_ADR+1
;
SIN_X   =       SIN_X+(SIN_Y/41)
SIN_Y   =       SIN_Y-(SIN_X/41)
;
REPTCNT =       REPTCNT-1
        .IF     REPTCNT
        .ELSE
        GENSINUS
        .ENDIF
        ENDMAC
;
;=====================
        ORG     #8000
;
SIN_X           EQU     0
SIN_Y           EQU     #7F00
SIN_ADR         EQU     $
        GENSINUS
REPTCNT         =       64
        ORG     SIN_ADR+256
;
